citations.assessment: Mattanya describes hearing Yoḥanan and Yishmael, sons of Yeshua as written in this witness. The source identifies Mattanya as the hearer, not as a third son.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The reciprocal says Mattanya heard the two sons while on business. Its chapter 4 locator differs from the verified chapter 7 passage.
